map.MA(n) = 最近 n 日收盘价算术平均。反映趋势方向，金叉（短上穿长）看多，: MA(n) = arithmetic mean of the most recent n days' closing prices. Reflects trend direction; golden cross (short above long) is bullish, death cross (short below long) is bearish.
map.DIF上穿DEA为金叉看多，下穿为死叉看空。: DIF crossing above DEA is a golden cross (bullish); crossing below is a death cross (bearish).
map.RSI = 100 × 平均涨幅 ÷ (平均涨幅 + 平均跌幅): RSI = 100 × average gain / (average gain + average loss)
map.= (今收盘 - N日最低) ÷ (N日最高 - N日最低) × 100: = (today's close - N-day low) / (N-day high - N-day low) × 100
map.MA(N) = Σ最近N个收盘价 / N；MACD：DIF = EMA(快) −: MA(N) = sum of the last N closes / N; MACD: DIF = EMA(fast) - EMA(slow), DEA = EMA(DIF, 9), histogram = (DIF - DEA) × 2; RSI = 100 - 100 / (1 + avg gain / avg loss); KDJ: RSV = (C - L9)/(H9 - L9)×100, K/D recursively smoothed, J = 3K - 2D
map.MA 为 N 日收盘均价；MACD 取快慢 EMA 之差（DIF）与其 9 日: MA is the N-day average close; MACD takes the difference of fast and slow EMAs (DIF) and its 9-day EMA (DEA), with the histogram twice their difference; RSI uses average gain/loss to gauge overbought/oversold; KDJ first computes RSV then smooths K/D, and the J line amplifies signals.
map.本工具仅计算指标数值，不构成投资建议。实际交易需结合成交量、形态等多因素综合判断: This tool only computes indicator values and does not constitute investment advice. Real trading needs a combined judgment of volume, patterns and other factors.

map.趋势（MA 多空排列）、超买超卖（RSI）、动能（MACD 金叉/死叉）判断。: Judgment of trend (MA long/short alignment), overbought/oversold (RSI) and momentum (MACD golden/death cross).

map.最近 20 日收盘均价，如 [48,49,50,51,52…] 均值为 50 →: Average close of the last 20 days, e.g. [48,49,50,51,52…] mean = 50 → MA20 = 50. Price crossing above MA20 is often seen as short-term strengthening.
map.RSI = 100 − 100/(1+RS)，RS=14 日平均涨幅/平均跌幅。: RSI = 100 - 100/(1+RS), RS = 14-day average gain / average loss. RSI > 70 overbought, < 30 oversold. E.g. if gains exceed losses over 14 days RS = 2 → RSI = 100 - 100/3 ≈ 66.7 (strong but not overbought).
map.DIF=EMA12−EMA26；DEA=EMA(DIF,9)；MACD柱=DIF: DIF = EMA12 - EMA26; DEA = EMA(DIF, 9); MACD histogram = DIF - DEA. DIF crossing above DEA is a golden cross (bullish).
map.不能。技术指标滞后且易假信号，宜多指标+量价+基本面共振，且严格止损。: No. Technical indicators lag and give false signals easily; combine multiple indicators + volume/price + fundamentals, and use strict stop-losses.
